title: Article on the Resident's Right of Rescission, Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
**Right of rescission.** The resident may rescind the Entrance Fee Agreement by a signed rescission notice, for any reason and without penalty, within the rescission period of the campus.

**Period.** The agreement may be rescinded only within the rescission period after the agreement is signed. The rescission period is counted in calendar days from the signing date, the signing date being day 0, and a rescission notice signed on the last day of the period is effective. The period is the one the campus schedule assigns to the campus named in the agreement, and the signing date is the date on the agreement record.

**Refund.** On rescission the plan's rescission refund percentage of all money paid is refunded no later than the plan's rescission refund period, in calendar days, after the rescission, without any processing fee or amortization.

**Before occupancy only.** Rescission is possible only before occupancy; after the period ends a cancellation before occupancy follows the pre-occupancy cancellation terms.

**Signature.** The rescission notice must be signed by the resident or by a representative whose authority on the customer profile is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or a guardianship. The authority is read from the customer profile.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Campus | Period | Signed (day 0) | Notice signed | Day number | Effective as rescission |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur at Brookfield | 30 days | 1 March | 31 March | 30 | Yes |
| Larkspur at Brookfield | 30 days | 1 March | 1 April | 31 | No |
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | 7 days | 1 March | 8 March | 7 | Yes |
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | 7 days | 1 March | 9 March | 8 | No |

## Signer check

| Who signs the notice | Accepted |
|---|---|
| The resident | Yes |
| Representative recorded with financial power of attorney, durable power of attorney or guardianship | Yes |
| Anyone else | No |

The refund on an effective rescission is the full rescission percentage of everything paid: no processing fee is retained and no amortization is taken.
